```plato

    //==
    // AngleInterval — a directed angular range / arc sweep (items 11, 14).
    // Convention: endpoints are INCLUSIVE and the sweep is the CCW (increasing-angle)
    // arc from Start to End, which MAY cross the +/-pi seam — an arc from 170 deg to
    // -170 deg is the short 20 deg sweep across the seam, not the long way round. The
    // wrap-aware helpers below reduce every offset into [0, one turn) via Angle.Wrap
    // (angles.library.plato) before comparing, so they are stable across the seam,
    // unlike the generic linear IInterval.Contains/Extent (which read Start<=End
    // literally and are only correct for non-wrapping ranges). Union/Intersection are
    // deliberately NOT specialized for angular ranges: the union of two circular arcs
    // is not always an arc, so no sound closed form exists on this type; consumers
    // that need a set operation must work in the reduced [0, tau) parameter space.

    // The CCW angular width of the arc, reduced to [0, one turn). Unlike the generic
    // Extent (raw End - Start, which can be negative or exceed a turn), Span is the
    // seam-stable sweep magnitude: a full-turn arc (Start == End) reads as 0.
    Span(self: AngleInterval): Angle
        => (self.End - self.Start).Wrap(1.0.Turns);
```
